purpose: Define how every visible All Settings policy or setting row receives a manifest-backed documentation-help disposition and, when available, a localized row-level help link to the Firefox settings documentation.

source_authority.row_inventory: app/static/profiles_settings_inventory.js and app/static/profiles_settings_search.js identify visible All Settings entries; app/static/profiles_all_settings_list.js renders rows.
source_authority.policy_targets: documentation/config/firefox-policy-context-targets-0.9.0.json plus the generated ui-target-map policy:{exact_policy_id} entries.
source_authority.known_preference_targets: The Firefox documentation inventory declares known-preference:{exact.preference.id}; BPM091-M9-01 records that the current ui-target-map generator does not yet publish these entries, and BPM091-M9-02 owns closure.
source_authority.urls: app.documentation.manifest resolves links from target IDs and active locale; runtime code must never construct documentation URLs from labels.
source_authority.visual_style: app/templates/profiles/_context_help_icon.html and the .context-help-icon-link responsive contract provide the existing circled-i pattern.
source_authority.labels: locale-owned BPM UI catalogs for row help action, unavailable, missing, raw, and unknown dispositions.

visible_surfaces: review rows in All Settings mode
configured rows in All Settings mode
catalog rows in All Settings mode
search-result rows in All Settings mode
budgeted, paginated, or incrementally appended All Settings rows
rows rendered with long localized labels in every supported locale
must_cover: generated policy or preference rows with exact identifiers
rows whose target exists but the installed documentation artifact is unavailable, stale, incomplete, or incompatible
rows whose target is missing from the manifest ui-target-map

rules.identity_source: raw imported key without a recognized policy/preference identity
unknown imported key without a recognized policy/preference identity

target_resolution.invalid_rows: Invalid rows still resolve by exact identity when possible; the link label and state must not imply that the setting value is valid.
target_resolution.deprecated_rows: Deprecated rows still link when a manifest target exists; deprecation remains a row/status concern and must not suppress valid documentation.
target_resolution.missing_docs: Rows with no ui-target-map entry must render a stable no-link disposition and must not emit broken anchors.
target_resolution.unavailable_artifacts: If the installed documentation artifact is unavailable, stale, incomplete, or incompatible, every affected row uses the corresponding no-link disposition and follows existing localized documentation-unavailable states.

ui_contract.control: A row-level documentation action is displayed as the same circled letter i pattern used by existing BPM context-help icon links.
ui_contract.placement: right side of the setting or policy row, aligned with row metadata and value columns without covering labels or status badges
ui_contract.interactive_markup: The help link must not be nested inside an all-settings row button; implementation must split row selection and row help into sibling interactive controls or place the link outside the row button.
layout_stability: Adding the control must not change row height when the link appears, disappears, gains focus, or changes theme.
The control must remain visible in light, dark, system, forced-colors, compact, and narrow layouts.
Long localized labels must wrap or truncate according to existing row rules without overlapping the help link.
The row selection target must remain large enough for pointer users after the help link is added.

keyboard: Tab reaches row selection and the help link as separate controls.
Enter or Space on the row selection control selects the row.
Enter on the linked help action opens the manifest-resolved documentation URL.
The help link must not steal selection focus when navigating rows.
Focus indicators remain visible in light, dark, system, and forced-colors modes.
screen_reader: The accessible name includes the localized row label or exact policy/preference ID.
Unavailable and missing-documentation states are announced without exposing raw target-map internals.
The visible letter i is aria-hidden when a stronger localized accessible name is present.

requirements: Every linked row target ID must exist in the installed ui-target-map for the active documentation version.
Target validation must run against manifest target IDs, not translated labels or generated URLs.
Rows with no valid target must still expose one of the valid no-link dispositions.
Locale switching must re-resolve the same target ID to the active locale output when available.
Build-time and UI tests must fail closed for broken target IDs, missing dispositions, and anchors emitted for missing documentation.

browser_required_for: separate row-selection and help-link keyboard behavior
manifest-resolved localized links in all six locales
no overlap in compact, narrow, light, dark, and forced-colors layouts
documentation artifact unavailable, stale, incomplete, and incompatible states

non_goals: This contract does not implement the All Settings row help-link UI.
This contract does not add Firefox documentation topics or generate ui-target-map entries.
This contract does not link to external Firefox websites.
This contract does not hand-edit generated documentation output, manifests, search indexes, or installed app/documentation/site artifacts.
